Name: Silk Worm
Author: bruhthisdude25
Description:
✨ Features
🐛 Two New Coop Animals
[list]
[*][b]The Silkworm:[/b] Purchase a Silkworm Egg, place it in your Coop Incubator, and raise your very own Silkworms! They produce delicate [b]Silk Cocoons[/b] and have a chance to drop new eggs. Treat them well, and at high friendship, they might even spin ultra-valuable [b]Golden Silk Cocoons[/b]. (Includes custom chittering and squishing audio!)[/*]
[*][b]The Secret Void Silkworm:[/b] A dark, pulsing egg radiating strange energy. You won't find this at Marnie's shop! Seek out Krobus or check the Traveling Cart to get your hands on a Void Silkworm Egg. These mysterious creatures spin highly sought-after [b]Void Silk Cocoons[/b].[/*]
[/list]🌳 New Fruit Tree & Foraging
[list]
[*][b]The Mulberry Tree:[/b] Purchase a Mulberry Sapling from Pierre's shop. It takes 28 days to mature and bears sweet, tart [b]Mulberries[/b] during the Spring and Summer.[/*]
[*][b]Wild Foraging:[/b] Ancient Mulberry Trees blow their leaves across the valley. Forage for wild [b]Mulberry Leaves[/b] in the Forest and Secret Woods to feed your worms or process into artisan goods![/*]
[/list]🧵 A Massive Artisan Loop
Turn your farm into a textile and culinary empire! Use vanilla machines to process your new items:
[list]
[*][b]Loom:[/b] Spin Silk Cocoons into [b]Silk Cloth[/b], [b]Golden Silk Cloth[/b], and [b]Void Silk Cloth[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Preserves Jar:[/b] Turn Mulberries into [b]Mulberry Jelly[/b], or ferment Mulberry Leaves into [b]Pickled Leaves[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Keg:[/b] Brew fresh Mulberries into sweet, dark purple [b]Mulberry Wine[/b] (can be aged in casks!).[/*]
[*][b]Mayonnaise Machine:[/b] Process Silkworm Eggs and Void Silkworm Eggs into rich [b]Silkworm Mayo[/b] and pungent [b]Void Silkworm Mayo[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Oil Maker:[/b] Press Mulberry Leaves to create highly concentrated [b]Mulberry Extract[/b].[/*]
[/list]🥧 Custom Cooking
[list]
[*][b]Mulberry Pie:[/b] A warm, flaky pie filled with sweet and tart mulberries. Cook it in your kitchen using 1 Mulberry, 1 Wheat Flour, and 1 Sugar for a massive energy boost![/*]
[/list]📜 Lore, Mail, & Quests
This mod feels like a native part of Stardew Valley with deep story integration:
[list]
[*][b]Marnie's Loom:[/b] The first time you harvest a Silk Cocoon, Marnie will send you a congratulatory letter with a complimentary Loom to get your business started.[/*]
[*][b]Emily's Fashion Emergency:[/b] A custom late-game Special Order! Check the town board to help Emily source 10 Golden Silk Cloths for her new collection. Complete it for a massive 15,000g payout and a personalized thank-you letter.[/*]
[/list][heading]⚙️ Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the
[code]Silk Worm Mod[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game and enjoy![/*]
[/list][heading]💡 How to Play (Quick Start Guide)[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Buy a [b]Mulberry Sapling[/b] from Pierre and plant it to start growing your berry supply.[/*]
[*]Forage for wild [b]Mulberry Leaves[/b] in the forest.[/*]
[*]Buy a [b]Silkworm Egg[/b] (from Marnie or the Traveling Cart) and place it in your Coop Incubator.[/*]
[*]Wait 4 days for your Silkworm to mature.[/*]
[*]Collect [b]Silk Cocoons[/b] and toss them into the Loom to weave Silk Cloth![/*]
[*]Expand your empire by befriending your worms for Golden Silk, or visiting Krobus for the secret Void Worms.[/*]
[/list]
